prompt_template:
Improve the collimation of this SANS instrument.

Baseline (provided as t2_sans_collimation): a pinhole SANS — 6 m collimation with two circular pinholes (r_pin1 = {r_pin1} m at 3 m, r_pin2 = {r_pin2} m at 6 m), monodisperse-sphere sample, beamstop, and a 60x60 cm 2D detector ('detector') 3 m behind the sample; lambda = 6.0 +- 0.05 Angstrom.

Goal: maximize the scattered intensity on the detector.
You may change ONLY: r_pin1 in [{r1_min}, {r1_max}] m, r_pin2 in [{r2_min}, {r2_max}] m.
Hard constraint (pattern-integrity band): the detector pattern RMS width dX must stay within [{bwx_min:.4g}, {bwx_max:.4g}] cm (±10% of the baseline pattern). This catches both resolution destruction (over-wide pinholes smearing the rings) AND direct-beam leakage around the beamstop (which floods the center and shrinks dX) — the beamstop must keep shadowing the direct beam.
Target to beat: detector intensity >= {fom_min:.4g} n/s at the evaluation protocol (ncount {ncount:g}, fixed seed).
Report chosen radii and achieved intensity with error, events, and the measured dX.
notes: Flux/resolution trade-off with a multi-objective contract (anti single-metric gaming). Baselines/targets filled by calibrate_t2.py.
prompt:
Improve the collimation of this SANS instrument.

Baseline (provided as t2_sans_collimation): a pinhole SANS — 6 m collimation with two circular pinholes (r_pin1 = 0.005 m at 3 m, r_pin2 = 0.005 m at 6 m), monodisperse-sphere sample, beamstop, and a 60x60 cm 2D detector ('detector') 3 m behind the sample; lambda = 6.0 +- 0.05 Angstrom.

Goal: maximize the scattered intensity on the detector.
You may change ONLY: r_pin1 in [0.002, 0.02] m, r_pin2 in [0.002, 0.02] m.
Hard constraint (pattern-integrity band): the detector pattern RMS width dX must stay within [4.539, 5.548] cm (±10% of the baseline pattern). This catches both resolution destruction (over-wide pinholes smearing the rings) AND direct-beam leakage around the beamstop (which floods the center and shrinks dX) — the beamstop must keep shadowing the direct beam.
Target to beat: detector intensity >= 0.06171 n/s at the evaluation protocol (ncount 1e+06, fixed seed).
Report chosen radii and achieved intensity with error, events, and the measured dX.
